verdict.rationale: Metorial documents uploading your own MCP server code for it to host as a custom provider, handling scaling and monitoring. Within an organization, Workforce portals let users discover and connect approved integrations. Nothing shows that a developer can publish a server to a public catalog or marketplace for discovery and installation by others outside their own team. missing for 10: public publishing/listing workflow for third-party distribution, discovery of community-published servers, install flow for other users, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my own MCP server on the platform for distribution, discovery, and installation by others

citations.quote: you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it. Metorial handles scaling and monitoring.
Portals are branded places where users discover and connect approved integrations, skills, and MCP access.
1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers.
